llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed connector for Rosette text analysis, with no hidden code or evidence of unrelated access.

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently supports Rosette Text Analytics through the OOMOL oo connector, listing only text-analysis actions such as sentiment, entity extraction, language identification, categories, and tokens.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger wording is broad for Rosette-related requests, but it remains scoped to that service and tells the agent to inspect schemas before running actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only SKILL.md and no executable script, but first-time setup includes disclosed oo CLI installation commands using remote installer URLs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The allowed tool scope is limited to Bash commands beginning with oo, which is proportionate for operating an OOMOL connector.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Authentication and connector setup may persist an OOMOL/Rosette account connection, but the instructions say not to run login or open the connection page proactively and to use setup only after relevant failures.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending selected text to Rosette Text Analytics through OOMOL. Review the oo CLI installer source before running first-time setup, and only connect your Rosette account when you intend to use this service.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: The setup/auth instructions do expand beyond passive analysis, but they are disclosed as conditional first-time setup and not hidden or automatic.
[SQP-1] expected: The routing language is broad, but it applies to Rosette Text Analytics requests specifically and does not authorize unrelated tools, data access, or background behavior.
